shortDescription: Roche Holding AG plans to deploy new laboratory equipment in Ituri, the epicenter of the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak, according to Bloomberg.Authorities are struggling to contain the virus, which has repeatedly outpaced the response.
